text:
Alexa Chen: Quick sync — Snowflake + Databricks connector with vector DB adapters (Pinecone/Milvus/Weaviate) — want to align on launch checklist, marketplace listing, and co-marketing timeline. Targeting public availability ~Apr 15. Who can own what? :calendar:
Matt Rodriguez: I can take infra readiness and canary in hosted. Need to confirm autoscale profiles and perf SLOs.
Sara Iqbal: I’ll own docs, sample notebooks, and quickstart. Will need sample SQL and a Python notebook showing upsert + embed pipeline.
Jamal Turner: I’ll handle partner ops (logos, joint announcement approvals, legal + embargo). Also need partner contact for marketplace metadata.
Alexa Chen: Great. Key items I see:
- infra canary + perf tests (Matt)
- e2e integration tests + CI (Matt/Sara)
- docs + notebooks (Sara)
- connector packaging (wheel/container) + versioning strategy (Matt)
- vector DB adapters validation (Sara)
- security review & KMS/network requirements (security/infra)
- marketplace listing assets + pricing SKU + partner form (Jamal)
- joint blog + social assets + embargo date (Jamal + marketing)
Matt Rodriguez: For packaging: propose producing a docker image and a pip wheel. Image tags: rdinference/connector:snowflake-databricks-v1.0. We should include an env-based config to switch vector adapters.
Sara Iqbal: Draft snippet for docs (will expand):
```yaml
connector:
  source: snowflake
  snowflake_account: "<acct>"
  databricks_cluster: "<cluster>"
  vector_db: pinecone  # options: pinecone, milvus, weaviate
  embedding_model: redwood-embed-1
```
Jamal Turner: Marketplace checklist I need filled: partner ID, support contact, pricing tiers (free/dev, paid), legal MSA copy, logos (SVG+PNG), screenshots, 2-line blurb, and a short demo video. Also confirm whether we list as "Connector" or as a managed "Integration" offering.
Alexa Chen: @Matt — can you add perf targets? thinking p99 latency < 250ms for retrieval path and throughput 100 req/s for batch upserts in Dedicated.
Matt Rodriguez: Will run perf suite this week and post results. Also will create a canary job that exercises Snowflake -> Databricks -> vector DB path.
Sara Iqbal: For notebooks I'll include: 1) quickstart (one cell for auth + one for upsert), 2) retrieval example with ranking, 3) troubleshooting guide for network errors. Will link to `examples/connectors/snowflake_databricks.ipynb`.
Alexa Chen: Security questions: do we need to support customer-managed keys (KMS) for payloads going to vector DBs? Also VPC peering diagrams for Private deployment customers.
Jamal Turner: Legal asked for the list of data flows and whether we persist PII. Please add a short data flow section in the doc. I’ll start partner marketing brief draft for approvals.
deploy-bot: Release branch created: `partners/connector/snowflake-databricks` by Alexa Chen (CI pipeline queued).
Matt Rodriguez: CI plan: unit tests + integration smoke in ephemeral cluster + canary rollout to 1% traffic. If canary passes 24h then 10%, then full.
Sara Iqbal: One more ask — we should add short guided demo for Sales with a troubleshooting cheat sheet. I can own an internal sales slide deck.
Alexa Chen: Awesome. Assignments recap: Matt = infra/canary/packaging, Sara = docs/notebooks/sales deck, Jamal = partner ops/marketplace/co-marketing. I’ll coordinate launch calendar and set embargo date next week.
Jamal Turner: FYI — partner PR lead prefers Apr 20-22 window; marketing needs 10 business days for assets.
Alexa Chen: Noted. I’ll update calendar and create the shared checklist doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/partners/snowflake-databricks-connector (draft). Please add items. :thumbsup:
Matt Rodriguez: Added perf tasks.
Sara Iqbal: Added notebook TOC.
Jamal Turner: Uploading logos and partner contact this afternoon.
Alexa Chen: Thanks all — quick pulse in #partners-sync on Friday to lock dates.
Matt Rodriguez: 👍
Sara Iqbal: 👍
Jamal Turner: 👍
